pages.title: From Crystal to Prism
pages.text: Start with a Processor: iron and wool make Arcane Ingots; the Prismatic Processor turns wool into color supplies. Four pedestals turn a diamond and three matching ingots into a gem; eight distinct gems craft a Prism.

pages.title: Arcane Ingots
pages.text: Drop one Iron Ingot and one wool block at the Processor to make one Arcane Ingot. All sixteen wool colors feed eight ingot colors on the next page.

pages.title: Wool to Ingot Colors
pages.text: White wool yields White. Lime and Green yield Green; Brown, Black, Gray, and Light Gray yield Black; Red yields Red; Orange yields Orange; Yellow yields Yellow; Blue, Light Blue, and Cyan yield Blue; Magenta, Pink, and Purple yield Violet.

pages.title: Matching Gem Recipes
pages.text: At four pedestals, use one diamond requiring 60,000 White power and three same-color Arcane Ingots requiring 20,000 White each. White accepts falling power of any color. See $(l:aura:consumers_vortex)Consumers and Vortex$(/l) for the ring setup.

pages.title: Eight Gem Colors
pages.text: The matching ingots produce White, Black, Orange, Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, or Violet Gems. Each color follows the same four-pedestal recipe; the White power requirement remains a wildcard for falling power.

pages.title: Arcane Prism
pages.text: Drop one gem of each distinct color (White, Black, Orange, Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, and Violet) near a normal Cascading Processor. It returns one Arcane Prism. This is a Processor recipe, not a vortex infusion.

pages.title: Cascading Synthesizer
pages.text: Connect a stored-power network block beside the Synthesizer. It needs no dropped input and emits one first-tier Angelsteel Ingot on completion: 50 progress at 10,000 base power per step.

pages.title: Angelsteel Tiers
pages.text: Drop three grounded Angelsteel Ingots of the same tier within three blocks of one another; they combine into one ingot of the next tier. Repeat up to tier 12. See $(l:aura:angelsteel_tools)Angelsteel Tools$(/l) and $(l:aura:angelsteel_swords)Angelsteel Swords$(/l) for crafting.

pages.title: Fluxing Node
pages.text: Combine a node and two Red Arcane Ingots to form a Fluxing Node.

pages.title: Export Stored Power
pages.text: Place insertable energy-storage blocks in a face-connected group touching the Fluxing Node and each other. Each second it exports stored power to up to four compatible receivers; five or more pause export. It spends one stored power per 15 energy inserted, rounded up.

pages.title: Prismatic Processor
pages.text: After making an Arcane Prism, craft the Prismatic Processor with the prism centered over the base Processor and glass in the remaining positions.

pages.title: Wool Colorants I
pages.text: At the Prismatic Processor, one wool block yields one result: White wool to Bone Meal; Orange wool to Orange Dye; Magenta wool to Magenta Dye; Light Blue wool to Light Blue Dye; Yellow wool to Yellow Dye; Lime wool to Lime Dye; Pink wool to Pink Dye; Gray wool to Gray Dye.

pages.title: Wool Colorants II
pages.text: One wool block yields one result: Light Gray wool to Light Gray Dye; Cyan wool to Cyan Dye; Purple wool to Purple Dye; Blue wool to Lapis Lazuli; Brown wool to Cocoa Beans; Green wool to Green Dye; Red wool to Red Dye; Black wool to Ink Sac.
